<img class="tool-icon" src="../../../../images/tekla/tools/uprojector.svg" alt="" width="48" height="48" style="display:block;margin:0 0 1rem;background:#fff;border-radius:8px;padding:4px" />

{{% callout type="info" %}}
**Where to find it:** Applications & Components → Comma → Model Edit → `uProjector` (also on the Comma ribbon tab, Model Edit block)
{{% /callout %}}

Projects objects onto a face, a plane, a point on the work plane, or a line, either moving them or creating copies.

**How to use:**

1.  Select the targets first, or pick them after the reference. Choose the options and click **Apply**.
2.  Pick the reference: a face, a three-point plane, a point through the current work plane, or a line.
3.  Repeat until <kbd>Esc</kbd>.

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Reference** | Face, Plane 3 points, point through the work plane, or Line. |
| **Direction** | How the projection runs onto the reference. |
| **Alignment** | For beams: Keep original, Align to plane, Align by OBB, OBB above/below plane, or Project nearest point. |
| **Action** | Move modifies the targets; Copy creates new objects. Project nearest point modifies the original beam even with Copy selected. |
| **Gap** | Signed, in mm. Metric arithmetic or imperial feet/inch fractions, according to XS\_IMPERIAL\_INPUT when the dialog opens. Blank keeps the previous gap. |

Line mode skips PolyBeam, ControlPolycurve and rebar targets, and a ControlPolycurve Move is refused before any other target is changed.

{{% callout type="warning" %}}
After an error some changes may remain: use Undo as needed.
{{% /callout %}}

**Rebar:** a SingleRebar or polygonal RebarGroup is projected like a plate: every input point of the bar, and the distribution points of a group, moves onto the plane along the chosen Direction (Gap shifts the plane). Move edits the bar; Copy duplicates it with all its attributes and user attributes and projects the copy. Hooks, end offsets and bend radii are not changed, and the beam-only Alignment options do not apply. Rebar can be preselected or picked after the reference. The picker takes parts and rebar; any other picked object is ignored and listed in a message. Rebar never blocks the other targets of a selection. A bar is skipped, and listed in a message after the run, when a leg runs along the projection direction (it would collapse), when a bend would fold flat, when the projection would change the distribution length or the distance between the polygons of a group (a spacing-based group would gain or lose bars), when the direction is parallel to the plane, in Line mode, and for component-owned bars, RebarSet bars, bars with child objects and spiral or curved groups; a RebarSet, mesh or strand is not supported. A bar that already lies on the plane is skipped silently, for Copy too. Every Move and Copy is read back; a Move that fails the read-back is put back and listed.

**More details:**

-   Blank retains the prior gap.
-   Invalid input blocks Apply; history displays the same units.
-   Reopen after unit changes.
-   On opening, standard attributes load and normalize: absolute Gap above 1e9 mm becomes 0, negative indices become first option and Action becomes Move/Copy.
-   Normalized attributes apply without starting a model operation.
